newsitem.title: USA: Talley holder may solicit proxies.
newsitem.headline: Talley holder may solicit proxies.

text.p: A major stockholder in Talley Industries said on Wednesday he would solicit proxies at the company's 1997 annual meeting.

In a statement, Saad Alissa, owner of 1.1 million, or 7.55 percent, of Talley shares, said he would take the move "in light of Talley's consistent refusal to respond constructively to proposals by him for the purpose of strengthening performance and management and enhancing shareholder value."
Alissa made a proxy filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday.

The filing said "such proxies may be solicited for a number of purposes, which may include (1) electing directors in opposition to management's nominees; (2) eliminating anti-takeover provisions ... and (3) taking other appropriate actions to adopt structural and management changes to enhance corporate democracy, to make the company more responsive to shareholders and increase shareholder value."
